column1: # vibejuel1649 key: the OLD cipher ("gamle Ciffres") of Peder Vibe's letters to Peder Juel, 1649-1651 (Rigsarkivet, TKUA Sverige,
# unit 261583, images 62-74), CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffree, 2026; PR #410).
# Recovered from the letters themselves: the shift-per-word system was found on N. 319 (image 78, new alphabet, in
# targets/vibejuel1651) from its partial interlinear decipherment of the time; the old cipher's own alphabet and opener rule
# were then worked out on N. 330 (image 74) and the letters of 1649-50, which carry no gloss. Vibe names the cipher in clear on
# image 62 (11 Jan 1649): "wed woris forige gamble Ciffres".
# A cipher word = OPENER + BODY. The opener (first number, 24-39) gives a shift k; each body number n stands for the letter of
# rank n - k (1-based, taken mod 23). In the body, 32/33/34 stand for 1/2/3.
#   23 letters, i = j, u = v/w, CYCLIC: a with k = -1 is written 23; a with k = -2 is 22.
#   The 21st letter is x (perplex, sex); the hand of 1649-51 has no w.
# Nomenclator: two- and three-digit numbers between the words (22 different ones in these letters: 35, 44, 46, 109, 211, 212, 228,
# Columns: section, cipher (letter value at k = 0, or opener list), value, note.

column4: body value at k = 0; with shift k the letter of rank n - k (mod 23)
